entries.title: Bank Geometry
entries.summary: A knowledge-only concept with no learning policy.
entries.body:
The Learning Runtime must reject this Concept rather than inventing a default
policy.

payload.explanation: Bank geometry relates incoming and outgoing cushion paths.
keyPoints: Geometry is a starting model rather than a player mastery policy.

entries.title: Bank Alignment Left
entries.summary: The bank repeatedly misses to the left.
entries.body: This correction is intentionally tied to the Bank Shot fixture.

payload.symptom: The object ball repeatedly misses left of the target pocket.
payload.correction: Recheck the cushion contact point before changing speed.
causes: The selected cushion contact point is too shallow.

entries.title: Bank Alignment Right
entries.summary: The bank repeatedly misses to the right.
entries.body: This second equal-score correction proves stable semantic-ID ranking.

payload.symptom: The object ball repeatedly misses right of the target pocket.
payload.correction: Recheck the cushion contact point before changing speed.
causes: The selected cushion contact point is too deep.

entries.title: Bank Shot
entries.summary: Control a one-cushion bank with an advanced deterministic protocol.
entries.body:
This fixture proves that an advanced Technique uses the same compiled learning
pipeline without a Knowledge-ID branch.

outcome.description: Pocket the bank shot under the defined setup.

measurement.successDefinition: The object ball is pocketed from the fixed bank setup.

drill.title: Fixed One-Cushion Bank
instructions: Use the fixed LR-1 bank layout.

entries.title: Kick Shot
entries.summary: Independent advanced Technique used to prove Evidence isolation.
entries.body:
Kick Shot must not inherit Bank Shot evidence even though both use the same
advanced mastery policy.

outcome.description: Contact the target ball from the fixed kick-shot setup.

measurement.successDefinition: The cue ball contacts the target from the fixed setup.

drill.title: Fixed One-Cushion Kick
instructions: Use the fixed LR-1 kick layout.
